title: Gauge Symmetry Beyond Perturbation Theory: BRST and anti-BRST Structure, Background Fields, and Infrared Dynamics of Yang--Mills Theory
summary: We present a pedagogical and self contained account of the functional formulation of non-Abelian gauge theories, aimed at the construction of a process independent effective charge for Yang--Mills theory. Starting from the path integral quantization of gauge fields, we review gauge fixing and the emergence of Faddeev--Popov ghosts, illustrating how gauge invariance is preserved at the quantum level through Becchi--Rouet--Stora--Tyutin (BRST) symmetry.
